div.div: DML write sets, relationships, guards and retry behavior. Each TX is an implementation contract, not a stored procedure already installed.

div.div: TX-01 / Register, verify, sign in, reset and revoke

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 218px; margin-left: 64px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Normalized unique email; verified active identity required for purchase. Rate limit outside
DB; reset/verification token must be unconsumed and unexpired.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock user then affected sessions/account_token rows in sorted ID order.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT app_user/account_token/auth_session; consume token conditionally; update
verification/password hash; revoke old sessions on reset/logout/suspension; INSERT audit
and outbox notification intents.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
All session/token rows retain user_id. Replacement tokens are new rows/digests; do not
change token purpose.
FAILURE / RETRY
Unique email resolves registration race. Reused/expired token rolls back. Never email raw
secrets via persistent plaintext outbox: generate a signed-purpose link from stored
challenge ID/key at dispatch or protect a one-time secret with encryption.

div.div: TX-02 / Organizer creation, staff invite/accept, grants/revocation

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 218px; margin-left: 804px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Owner or explicit manage_staff permission; invite email matches verified account. Scanner
is an organization member with event-limited capabilities.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock involved users/sessions, organization, member, then event when assigning/revoking
event capabilities.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT organization, organization_member, staff_invitation, event_staff and permission
joins; mark invitation accepted/revoked; revoke membership/assignment and publish access-
change event.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Composite event_staff FKs force event and member into the same organization. owner_user_id
changes only in explicit ownership-transfer transaction to an active same-org member.
FAILURE / RETRY
Never remove the owner through membership revoke. Invitation replay is no-op/error;
unauthorized changes roll back. Revoke WebSocket subscriptions and device packages after
commit.

div.div: TX-03 / Create/configure event, layout, ticket types and capacity

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 698px; margin-left: 64px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Authorized event editor. Layout belongs to venue; seat modes cannot change after active
allocations. Validate named timezone, seat coordinates and sales/admission/refund windows.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock organization/event, relevant ticket_types and event_seats; serialize with holds and
refunds.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT/UPDATE event, event_seat, ticket_type, event_media; snapshot seat labels on event
copy. Reject capacity/type-limit reduction below all held/sold/quarantine allocations.
Increment event availability_version when relevant; INSERT audit.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Template layout graph is venue > layout > section > row > seat. event_seat points to same
layout and same-event type; booked identities cannot be repointed.
FAILURE / RETRY
Reject blocking/retargeting an allocated seat. Layout/capacity changes that make counts
inconsistent roll back completely. Unallocated drafts may be edited; old paid snapshots
never change.

div.div: TX-04 / Publish, unpublish, update or suspend event

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 717px; margin-left: 804px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Publication needs complete event, usable tickets, valid times; platform-only moderation.
Paid activation remains an independent gate.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock organization/event; read relevant types/activation under same event mutex.
DATABASE WRITES
UPDATE publication/moderation/time fields; increment calendar_sequence for calendar changes
and availability_version for gate changes; INSERT audit and notification/broadcast jobs.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Existing orders/tickets remain linked. Unpublish stops new sales without automatically
invalidating issued admission; suspension blocks new admission/fulfillment.
FAILURE / RETRY
No refund implied by suspension/unpublish. New updates cannot erase allocations. Pending
successful charges blocked from fulfillment route to compensation.
